purpose: Measure declared raw-name pointer cohorts through shared source and grammar owners, and report an independently scoped source-reference policy. This is read-only maintenance evidence, not patch admission.

owners.run: Strict profile routing, pinned optional SENT admission and the existing full-input identity/mtime/byte recheck loop before buffered JSON publication.
owners.references: Bounded table collection, occurrence projection, explicit nominal comparisons and source-policy joining. Repeated targets share immutable measurement facts; their occurrences keep distinct slots and indices.
owners.inspect: The existing font_metrics mode supplies guarded raw three-page metrics, including existing exception and native SPACE source guards.
owners.controls: The existing scanner measures the bounded first-END slice using a complete declared advance map. No legacy-specific scanner mode was added.
owners.indexInstructions_queryRegisterFlow: The existing instruction producer and one bounded graph supply definition/use facts. No second decoder, graph, registry fabrication, F112 handler or interpreter is introduced.
owners.readInput_checkJSON: The shared regular-file and strict JSON owners remain authoritative.

inputs.source: One pinned bounded source, with declared affine ELF VMA delta and existing Layout font facts.
inputs.sentinel: Optional registry_inputs.sentinel uses RegistryInput path, size and SHA256. A relative path is resolved beside the profile. references receives bytes explicitly and performs no file I/O.
inputs.queries: Named queries select one or more named ReferenceTable pointer-slot arrays through start/end/stride. Ends are exclusive; every selected occurrence is retained in source-array order. This route forbids registry selectors.
inputs.coordinates: Table slots are aligned four-byte source VMAs. occurrence is zero-based within each selected table; id is the exact slot VMA. Name targets may be odd when both bytes of each word exist. Physical source and SENT reads never cross backing artifacts.

nominal_measurement.formula: For glyphs 1 through 1322, advance = max(declared floor, left + ink + 3) - left. Glyph 0 uses declared SPACE. Glyphs 1323 through 2047 use declared fallback. The complete map is supplied to controls.
nominal_measurement.grammar: Only glyph words below 0x0800, LINE 0x0800 and END 0xf800 are admitted. END at word 100 succeeds; absence within the bound remains a diagnostic. Truncation, unsupported controls and out-of-domain pointers prevent a successful nominal comparison.
nominal_measurement.lines: LINE resets the accumulator. Empty and trailing lines remain visible. The cohort maximum is the maximum individual line width, never the sum across lines.
nominal_measurement.comparison: Each query declares expected occurrence count, expected maximum, nominal float64 scale and scaled limit. The historical 289 * 0.70 comparison is nominal float64 policy, not PS2 rounding or a rational equivalence theorem.
nominal_measurement.units: Historical nominal pen units. They are distinct from native exception advances, atlas source-grid rectangles and physical screen fit.
nominal_measurement.admission: Shared native metric admission is deliberately stronger than incidental legacy malformed-buffer behavior; neither the unfloored native advance nor bitmap renderer scale is substituted for this policy.

source_reference_policy.provider: tools/elf_references.py:Refs.find, using Code.reaching_defs and Code.uses_after from migrate_drafted_2026_09_30.py. Existing advisory candidate equality is not this policy.
source_reference_policy.scope: Profiles explicitly declare text file range, raw file range, data VMA range and raw pointer-value window. Legacy raw indexing is SENT through SENT+0x100000; this is distinct from the actual bounded SENT name-input range. A target outside the raw index is unknown, including valid names beyond that window. Empty retail buckets are by construction, not exhaustive absence.
source_reference_policy.buckets: Retain raw data-pointer sites, text hazards, equal-valued matching LUI/low pairs, ambiguous definitions, direct-memory and foreign-use problems. Pair order is deterministic low-site/definition-site normalization; Python set iteration is not promised ordered parity.
source_reference_policy.expectations: Declared pair coordinates, target/opcode and pointer buckets are explicit policy facts. Actual same-low readers are discovered from the existing instruction index before the definition/use join. Unsupported, incoming, call and work/word/query limits retain uncertainty.
source_reference_policy.resource_contract: Reuse the 256-site declared-bucket bound for retained raw pointer/problem observations per target. Before a 257th site/string allocation, set sticky limited state. Continue numeric checks with at most one first unexpected-pointer witness and one first post-cap text-hazard witness per target. No subsequent per-word site or string allocation occurs.
source_reference_policy.precedence: A limited prefix is incomplete even when it matches the expected prefix. Any known unexpected pointer or text hazard, including one after the cap, remains a refusal and outranks unknown. Nominal comparison success never closes ownership.
source_reference_policy.authority: Successful declared-policy observations do not establish whole-program reference parity, ABI, safe landing, loaded capacity or patch authorization.

source_basis.qualification: The original provider and dated review pins are preserved. No current canonical registry or actual game cohort is read or repinned by this increment.
